Output: (a) Interpretation Lock FIRST (one bullet per source line): - Line <ID> <copy exact source line> => Locked Meaning (truth-conditions) - If comparative/degree: define entities A,B, relation (>,<,≈), and degree (e.g., “slightly”). - Include key predicate-argument structure and modifier attachment/scope (what modifies what) when it affects meaning. - Note: A>B is equivalent to B<A; do not reverse the ordering. (b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 4 Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura 5 esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte 6 che nel pensier rinova la paura! Reference Translation (provided): Ah! how hard a thing it is to tell what this wild and rough and dense wood was, which in thought renews the fear!

**Interpretation Lock – ONE BULLET PER SOURCE LINE**
- **Line 4 – “Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura”** *Locked Meaning*: The speaker exclaims (Ahi) that the **difficulty** (quantified by “quanto”) of **saying** (“a dir”) **what it was** (“qual era”) is **extremely high**; the thing in question is a **hard‑to‑describe thing** (“è cosa dura”). *Predicate‑Argument Structure*: - **Main copular clause**: *cosa* (subject) **is** (*è*) *dura* (predicative adjective). - **Embedded infinitival clause** (*a dir qual era*) functions as the **complement of “quanto”** (how). - Within the embedded clause, *qual era* is a **relative interrogative** denoting the **identity of the referent (X)**. *Modifier Scope*: “quanto” scopes over the entire infinitival complement, intensifying the difficulty; “dura” modifies “cosa” directly.
- **Line 5 – “esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte”** *Locked Meaning*: The speaker points to **this forest** (*esta selva*) and attributes three coordinated properties to it: **wild** (*selvaggia*), **rough** (*aspra*), and **dense/strong** (*forte*). *Predicate‑Argument Structure*: - **Nominal phrase**: *esta selva* (head noun *selva* with demonstrative determiner *esta*). - **Coordinate adjectival modifiers** (*selvaggia*, *aspra*, *forte*) each **predicatively describe** the noun. *Modifier Scope*: The conjunction “e” links the three adjectives in a **right‑branching coordination**, each independently modifying *selva*.
- **Line 6 – “che nel pensier rinova la paura!”** *Locked Meaning*: The forest (*che* referring back to *selva*) **re‑creates** (“rinova”) **fear** (“la paura”) **whenever it is thought of** (“nel pensier”). *Predicate‑Argument Structure*: - **Relative clause** headed by *che* (subject) with verb *rinova* (transitive). - **Prepositional phrase** *nel pensier* functions as a **temporal/locative adjunct** indicating the mental context. - **Direct object** *la paura* receives the action of renewal. *Modifier Scope*: The adjunct *nel pensier* scopes over the entire verb phrase, specifying the condition under which fear is renewed.
